content:
Early autumn Amazon Prime Day deals are now live with a fresh batch of discounts, including $50 off the new Mac Studio and up to $150 off select M5 MacBook Air models. We're also tracking $500 off the silver and space gray 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pros, ongoing clearance discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, TV deals, and fresh markdowns on accessories from brands like Twelve South and Anker. See below for all the details.

$500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro at Amazon in silver and space gray

The latest M5 MacBook Air deals are still going strong, but we wanted to revisit this $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at Amazon — both the space gray and silver models are now available at this steep markdown.

Amazon now has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the lowest price we've tracked in months, but now both space gray and silver versions are in stock — the latter of which typically doesn't see many deals.

This machine normally retails for $3,199, so you'll save $500. While a lot of tech deals just bring the price back to a previous MSRP, this discount is actually $100 lower than what it was priced at before Apple's late June price hike.

Lowest price on the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $100 off, plus $150 off the 24GB model

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (regularly $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (regularly $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (regularly $1,999)

Rare clearance discounts on the small and medium black Apple Watch Ultra 3, plus up to $200 off other configurations

The new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is officially on sale with early launch deals across the lineup, but Amazon is also discounting the previous generation — still very capable — Apple Watch Ultra 3 for much less.

The black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the gorgeous Milanese Loop strap remains the most sought-after deal — regularly $899, now nearly $200 off. While it's the most eye-catching clearance discount, more configurations joined the markdown earlier this morning.

However, there's a catch: the rest of the configurations have already matched the price of that fancy fabric Milanese version above. But the nearly $200 markdown is only available for the large size, while medium and small sizes are now $100 off — these popular medium models don't typically see discounts:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Alpine Loop $699 (regularly $799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $799 (regularly $899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Trail Loop $699 (regularly $799) | Small

Again, the large black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop remains the best value, but considering how rare medium-sized deals can be, we thought we'd give you a heads up.

Apple's new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio is now $50 off at Amazon

With the relatively affordable early launch discount on the M6 Mac mini returning, those looking to upgrade to Apple's just-released 2026 Mac Studio can find an all-time low price at Amazon.

Amazon now offers the new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with free shipping.

This machine normally retails for $2,499, so you'll save $50. While the discount isn't huge, if you want to upgrade early, saving $50 is still nice — and it's $1 cheaper than the pre-order discount.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (regularly $2,499)

Amazon didn't previously sell the older Mac Studio configuration officially, so it's hard to predict the deal trajectory for this machine. So far, its early launch discount is similar to the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon is usually more aggressive when new Apple products launch, so it's hard to say whether this pro-level machine will see further discounts during Prime Day and Black Friday. It's not impossible that we could see nearly $100 or similar markdowns later this year, but we can't say for certain right now.

Either way, early buyers can save a bundle, and the M6 Mac mini's early deals have returned on some configurations, making it a great choice for those who don't need the power of the M5 Max and 36GB of RAM:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (regularly $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (regularly $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (regularly $1,299)
